description: This file defines a pre-processing function for issues, converting issue details into a structured dictionary with some data transformation. It appears to be part of a data migration or integration process related to issue tracking and project management within the ERPNext system.

methods.name: pre_process(issue)
methods.description: Pre-processes an issue object by extracting relevant fields and transforming the markdown body to HTML, also fetching the associated project name from the database.
